targeting:
(browserSettings.update.channel in ["release"]) && (version|versionCompare('156.4.0') <= 0) && ((experiment.slug in activeExperiments) || ((
    (
        (
            os.isWindows
            &&
            (os.windowsVersion >= 10)
        )
        &&
        (
            (
                ((defaultProfile|keys)|length == 0)
            )
            ||
            (
                ((currentDate|date - defaultProfile.currentDate|date) / 86400000 >= 28)
                &&
                (firefoxVersion > defaultProfile.firefoxVersion)
            )
        )
        &&
        isBackgroundTaskMode
    )
    ) && (version|versionCompare('143.!') >= 0) && (locale in ['de', 'en-CA', 'en-GB', 'en-US', 'es-AR', 'es-ES', 'es-MX', 'fr', 'it', 'ja', 'nl', 'pl', 'pt-BR', 'pt-PT', 'ru', 'zh-CN'])))
